overview_description.description:
Complir is a compliance platform tailored for the retail sector, assisting businesses in managing regulations and ensuring product compliance throughout the design and delivery process. It consolidates product data to ensure regulatory adherence and improve transparency across the supply chain. The platform helps retailers maintain standards and stay informed about regulatory updates by automating reporting and simplifying data management. Complir supports retailers in improving compliance and operational efficiency in their product offerings.

https://www.complir.io/

about_short_description.short_description: Complir is a compliance platform designed for the retail sector to help businesses manage regulations and improve product compliance.

product.name: Complir Compliance Platform
product.description: A platform that centralizes product compliance data and automates regulatory tasks for retail businesses to manage evolving EU, US, and global regulations.

product.name: Automated Risk Assessment
product.description: A service that analyzes product risks, identifies harmful chemicals, and recommends necessary tests using internal and external regulatory data.

product.name: AI Chat for Compliance Queries
product.description: An AI-powered chat tool that provides precise answers to compliance-related questions about product testing and materials.

product.name: Compliance Reporting and Data Management
product.description: A tool that provides real-time overviews of product, sales, and purchasing data and generates reports to meet EU and regional compliance requirements.
